findings.finding: Clear broad front return, quiet inert medium and external right maintenance corridor are visible; no ghost, revived person or authoritative supernatural imagery. Right wall does not show the requested direct doorway between chamber and corridor. External corridor could connect around foreground, but a full bypass route avoiding the chamber must be established in adjacent-map topology before gameplay use. Ledger split cannot be treated as readable factual/subjective UI at this scale.

Three distinct instruments are visible: left tube, central spindle/position plate, right single-needle dial. Domestic capped stub stays high left with a large gap from common manifold; right closed waste tank sits in a bund. Three lower valve branches, backup tools and dry left return are present. Common top manifold is a conceptual proposal, not proof of independent measurement, hydraulic isolation, containment safety or passing readings; no NE5 certification follows from decorative dial/valve positions.

Table is unoccupied; five empty stools instead of four requested are a noncanonical furniture discrepancy. Board has five empty left pegs and five blank unsigned right slips; tied packet has no visible signature and horizontal timer is inactive staging. Closed private cabinet compartment and clear front return are present. No consent, attendance, accepted agreement, deadline or ending selection is implied. Gameplay board must populate only actual registered conditions and keep missing authorizations explicit.

overall: Selected images remain usable as review concepts with explicit topology, mechanical and state-binding caveats. No certified runtime or consent/ending outcome.
